critical_code_review_comments: routers/owner_dashboard.py::docs_engagement — Clean SQL rollup with func.count/distinct/max on AuditLog. Uses base_q.with_entities to avoid re-running the filter block. `latest_at` correctly ISO-formats a naive UTC into an aware ISO string. CATALOG.get(slug, {}).get('title') falls back to raw slug — safe against catalog drift. All good.

routers/docs_library.py — Every /pdf and /raw route calls audit_service.record + db.commit before returning the payload, guaranteeing the audit row is durable even if the client bails on the download. Content-Disposition inline/attachment toggle via `preview` bool is correct. Path traversal is nipped in `docs_library_service.CATALOG` (whitelist only).

services/docs_library_service.py::_md_to_pdf — xhtml2pdf is called synchronously; PDF is cached on disk keyed by mtime_ns so edits invalidate. Rendered PDFs are 60-100 KB for 500+ line manuals — well under the 20 KB floor asserted by tests.

frontend/DocsEngagementTile.tsx — Uses useQuery with 5 min staleTime — good caching. Empty state (data-testid=docs-engagement-empty) branches on total===0. Non-negotiable data-testid coverage for all 3 stat boxes + top-list items. Loading state also has a testid. Solid.

frontend/OrganizationDocumentsTab.tsx — Blob-URL approach for iframe preview is the correct pattern to work around JWT-gated PDF endpoints (the browser cannot attach Authorization to an iframe src). Blob URLs are revoked on unmount (useEffect cleanup) + on preview close — no memory leak. Preview iframe has data-testid='doc-preview-iframe' as required.
